programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on; Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces; the consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate.

programme.title: American Hostage
programme.desc: Having sold the lie of immunity on-air and successfully convinced Tony to sign the agreement, Fred now finds himself shut out of law enforcement's plans to bring this crisis to an end today, one way or another.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: The film follows the life of Homer Wells (Tobey Maguire), a precocious orphan who leaves his lifelong home and his loving tutor, Dr. Larch (Michael Caine) to explore the world. While Homer struggles to make a life for himself on his own, he must make monumental decisions that will change the course of his future and deeply affect the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Alliances fracture as the voyage wears on; Bess and Graham play a cat-and-mouse game, while Long John targets Jim; when Graham makes his move, the truth surfaces; the consequences are deadly and Jim is forced to take control of his fate.

programme.title: American Hostage
programme.desc: Having sold the lie of immunity on-air and successfully convinced Tony to sign the agreement, Fred now finds himself shut out of law enforcement's plans to bring this crisis to an end today, one way or another.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan.

programme.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
programme.desc: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner.

programme.title: Dead Again
programme.desc: When a mute woman suffering from amnesia arrives at the gates of an old orphanage, private investigator Mike Church is asked to find out who she is. With the help of a hypnotist, the woman regains her voice and recalls vivid memories of a couple from the 1940s torn apart by murder. Church begins to develop feelings for the woman, who he calls Grace, and then discovers he has a connection to the tragic couple from the 40s.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: Young Ben Crandall (Ethan Hawke) spends his free time watching sci-fi films, playing video games and reading comic books. Surprisingly, his affinity for all things fantastical yields a real result -- when he has a vivid dream about technology, his science-loving friend Wolfgang Muller (River Phoenix) manages to create a working spacecraft. Joined by their buddy Darren Woods (Jason Presson), the boys take off into outer space and encounter some very odd extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: A teenage Sherlock Holmes (Nicholas Rowe) meets and befriends his future sidekick, the bemused and bespectacled John Watson (Alan Cox). During their first semester of boarding school, a series of deaths occur on campus. Intrigued by the crime, Holmes looks into it and soon comes to suspect a poisonous hallucinogen. And then, in the midst of their investigation, Holmes and Watson stumble on a bizarre cult with a penchant for human sacrifice -- after which they must struggle to escape.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms.

programme.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: After a near-death experience during a routine colonoscopy, people-hating dentist Bertram Pincus is shocked to discover that he is suddenly able to talk to the dead. Constantly cornered by unhappy spirits who want him to help resolve their earthly problems, the misanthropic Pincus is driven to distraction. Eventually talked into helping the dearly departed Frank Herlihy, Pincus attempts to talk to Frank's widow, Gwen.

programme.title: Hunter
programme.desc: HUNTER® is an exciting new series being produced by Hunter Brand Media and hosted by Dave Poteat, that explores the different ways people use their natural hunter element. The first season is rooted in good ole North American big game hunting which is where Host, Dave Poteat's roots run the deepest. But as the series grows in the years to come, we will venture out from the comforts of the Whitetail woods from time to time to see how others act on their Hunter Element.

programme.title: Greg McHale's Wild Yukon
programme.desc: Greg McHale brings a passionate spirit of adventure to his big game hunts in Canada's wild Yukon, creating inspiring and intense journeys that push him physically and mentally; following him as he brings his family into the wilderness, creates shared memories and passes on the traditions we all love.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons

programme.title: Chasing the 29
programme.sub-title: Above The Timberline: British Columbia Stone Sheep

programme.title: The Most Wanted List
programme.desc: While Cowboy steps away on business, the rest of the crew tends to theirs in the field.

programme.title: Roger Raglin Outdoors
programme.desc: Join host Roger Raglin for one exciting whitetail adventure after another. Roger Raglin Outdoors features all big game but is predominately whitetail hunting utilizing a variety of hunting methods: bow, rifle and black powder. As a true outdoorsman and an exceptional big hunter, Roger shares a lifetime of tricks and techniques to help you in your quest for big game.

programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show [NEW]
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.desc: Christopher, le propriétaire du Deraney's Two City Tavern, est en train de tout perdre; sa maison, son restaurant et sa réputation; Irvine doit l'aider à comprendre son marché, à changer son éthique de travail et à se racheter auprès de ses employés.

programme.title: Restaurant impossible
programme.desc: Katie, propriétaire du Grille n° 13, s'est endettée de 350 000 $; elle n'a plus de temps à consacrer à sa fille; Irvine doit lui apprendre à travailler plus intelligemment si elle veut sauver son pub irlandais et retrouver du temps avec sa fille.

programme.title: Jamie cuisine à petits prix
programme.desc: Jamie cuisine un ragoût de poivrons d'inspiration italienne. Il prépare un savoureux poulet rôti économique, de délicieux kebabs et des pains plats faits maison, ainsi que des pommes farcies à la crème anglaise cuites à l'air chaud. Que du bonheur!

programme.title: Le combat des gâteaux géants
programme.desc: Les squelettes aussi ont faim; Brad Smith met la table pour les juges Danni Rose, Eddie Jackson et Ron Ben-Israel en invitant les équipes de pâtissiers à servir des gâteaux succulents où des squelettes affamés ont envie de manger.

programme.title: Le combat des gâteaux géants

programme.title: Le championnat de pâtisserie junior

programme.title: Hot Ones Québec

Le champion de la NBA a livré une excellente joute en relatant sa jeunesse dans Montréal-Nord, sa relation avec sa mère, son côté mauvais perdant ainsi que sa passion de la mode.

programme.title: Tous contre Bobby Flay

programme.title: Le combat des gâteaux géants
programme.desc: Trois équipes de pâtissiers professionnels s'affrontent derrière les fourneaux; elles auront cinq heures pour créer des gâteaux monstres effroyablement bons.

programme.title: La fièvre des encans: nouvelle génération

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Tom utilise un fusil à chargement par la bouche traditionnel pour chasser le cerf avec Sean et Hank. La chasse à l'élan de Jake et Anika est couronnée de succès. programme.title: Prescription musicale

programme.title: Nature en équilibre
programme.desc: La réserve de la biosphère Manicouagan-Uapishka est fière de collaborer avec l'industrie pour créer un avenir durable ; cependant, son rêve est mis à l'épreuve quand son projet phare est menacé par le plus grand réservoir hydroélectrique.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.desc: Sébastien repousse ses propres limites physiques en améliorant sa performance au fameux test navette Léger-Boucher; pour l'aider dans sa quête, il n'hésite pas à appliquer les conseils d'un champion des burpees.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.desc: Sébastien veut comprendre ce qui motive les amoureux de l'extrême; pour ce faire, il va rencontrer la spécialiste du stress humain Catherine Raymond; il va lui-même s'exposer aux sensations fortes en pratiquant le trapèze.

programme.title: Sur le terrain avec les intervenants autochtones

programme.title: Sur le terrain avec les intervenants autochtones
programme.desc: À Manawan, un infirmier examine un garçon avec des problèmes respiratoires et soupçonne une infection aux conséquences parfois graves ; la directrice du Centre d'amitié autochtone de La Tuque explique que la guérison est plus qu'individuelle.

programme.title: Découverte
programme.desc: L'apnée sportive révèle d'étonnants mécanismes de survie du corps humain; climat: réconcilier les générations est-il la clé pour passer à l'action?; à quoi servent vraiment nos lobes d'oreille?

programme.desc: Le 4 novembre 1966, Venise vit une journée historique avec une montée des eaux record ; la place Saint-Marc est noyée sous 120 centimètres d'eau, pendant une trentaine d'heures ; la cité des Doges est submergée en totalité.

programme.title: Concevoir l'impossible
programme.desc: On voit le submersible qui plonge le plus creux au monde, le Triton 36000/2, alias le Limiting Factor.

programme.title: Trésors sous les mers
programme.desc: À des kilomètres sous la surface de la mer, le Titanic, un cuirassé de la Seconde Guerre mondiale et le mystérieux vol 19, révèlent leurs mystères enfouis.

programme.title: Sorcières : chronique d'un massacre

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: The Cow Jumped Over The Moon: Dr Pol is experiencing some unusual emergencies and animals acting wild - the only reasonable explanation they can think of is the full moon. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Waking the Dragon: The zoo's penguin colony gets annual exams, and the staff holds its collective breath as a rare pangolin pregnancy unfolds at the Columbus Zoo. (S3, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Trailer Park Terror: Simon and Siouxsie search for a seriously angry mamba and an elusive cobra spotted in a trailer park. Plus, a spitting cobra shows Simon who is boss. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Eden: The Okavango flood turns desert into a wildlife haven, drawing elephants and predators before the waters vanish once more. 7+ (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark Men
programme.desc: A team of audacious experts dare to catch, tag and examine great white sharks, who, with 3,000 teeth arranged in several rows, are one of the world's most dangerous predators. (S1, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Heartland Shellebration: Dr Ben examines award-winning cows, repairs a turtle's busted shell and aids a young calf with an extra appendage. 7+ (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Forest Babies: Journey into Australia's forests as koalas, cassowaries, tree kangaroos and more take their first steps through a wild and wondrous world. 7+ (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Young and Wild: Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food and an adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Blood in the Water: The team investigates a string of shark attacks on the east coast of Australia, putting local theories to the test and revealing fascinating biology. 12+. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Hazards: Lightning has struck an incoming flight. As engineers assess the damage, high winds lead to runway closures and another plane starts leaking a potentially dangerous liquid. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Porcupine Posse: Dr Oakley checks up on Bindi's pups to get them ready for adoption. Plus there's a problem infesting the reindeer at the AWCC. (S7, ep 10)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Hungry, Hungry Dragons: A rescued panther demands veterinary staff attention. Meanwhile, a pair of 'hangry' Komodo dragons come for dinner! 7+ (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Crocodile: Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: Australia's "boss crocs" faced near extinction from hunting and development, but these dominant predators continue to thrive today. 7+

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Croc v Hippo: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos, while a honey badger fights against leopards and wild dogs cause chaos. 12+. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Dinosaur Island: On the Isle of Wight, researchers have found the remains of an unknown species of dinosaur. This finding could change what is known about prehistoric life. (1 of 10) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Deadline Danger: When arctic storms kick off the coldest winter in a decade, Thord, Bjoern and Jo Roger dice with death in order to keep the ice roads open. (S6, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Rebellion: The forest residents turn on orphaned leopard Motsidi. Meanwhile, the hyenas cause havoc. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: Snakes In The City

programme.desc: Disco was all pervasive in the mid and early 70s. Towards the end of the decade, Punk stole the headlines but Disco still had the high street. Everyone was into it and getting down on it at the local discotheque. Join us in a celebration of all things Disco including performances by The Jacksons, Thelma Houston, Sylvester, Carl Douglas, George McCrae, Sister Sledge, McFadden and Whitehead, Eruption and Gloria Gaynor.

programme.title: Fungi: The Web of Life
programme.desc: Much of life on earth is connected by a vast, hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the world of plants and animals, another realm exists – the kingdom of fungi. Passionate biologist and writer Merlin Sheldrake travels the globe, exploring the secret world of fungi.

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: Arriving in Quingdao, Michael checks into his hotel - which is obviously like a Bavarian castle - and finds himself in a room that was once Chairman Mao's. Having climbed China's holiest mountain, he travels to Shangai to see the new face of the nation, then takes a steamboat trip on the Yangtze River.

programme.title: Miss Marple

programme.title: Fanny and Alexander
programme.desc: The story of two children belonging to a wealthy, extensive theatrical family in provincial Sweden in the early years of the 20th century, 10-year-old Alexander and his younger sister, Fanny. When their father dies unexpectedly during a performance and their mother decides to remarry, the children are forced to relocate to the austere home of their stern and rather coldhearted stepfather, Bishop Vergerus.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Reclusive film director Ingmar Bergman talks about his career from his home on the Baltic island of Faro. He talks of the childhood that shaped him, of how the art of film was often a comfort to him, of love and death and of his worst demons.

programme.title: To the Manor Born

programme.title: The Cleveland Show

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eine Harley-Motorradgang nervt alle Bewohner von South Park mit ihrem Lärm. Die Freunde versuchen, sie aus der Stadt zu ekeln, indem sie versuchen, die Biker zu beleidigen. Doch stattdessen bekommen die Freunde Probleme mit den Bürgern der Stadt.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Die Freundschaft von Stan und Kyle wird auf die Probe gestellt, weil Stan sich weigert, seinen Freund auf Facebook hinzuzufügen. Der Ärger geht erst richtig los, als Stan den falschen hinzufügt. Kyle sucht Hilfe, um das Problem zu lösen.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Auf einem Schulausflug erlebt Bob mit Louise einen Vater-Tochter-Moment. Gene und seine Freunde suchen Exponate der weiblichen Anatomie. Tina hinterfragt ihr schlechtes Image. Linda hilft streikenden Mitarbeitern bei ihren Parolen.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Bob trifft auf einen abtrünnigen und kompromisslosen Radio-DJ, der sein persönlicher Held ist. Währenddessen ist den Belchers mit ihrem Latein am Ende, weil ihnen die ganze Situation über den Kopf wächst, um ihr Comeback zu starten.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Steve und seine Freunde sind unter der Voraussetzung, entweder süße Mädchen oder Alkohol mitzubringen, zu einer Party eingeladen. Da sie keine gutaussehenden Mädchen kennen, die sie begleiten könnten, besorgen sie sich heimlich Alkohol.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Francine erlaubt dem zu Hause gelangweilten Stan, mit seinen Kollegen auszugehen. Doch der Abend wird zum Desaster, als einer von ihnen einen Mann anfährt. Roger und Hayley konkurrieren um die Gunst der Männer, bis Roger anscheinend gewinnt.

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Barbara erfährt, dass Tariq mit der Mutter einer Schülerin seiner Klasse zusammen ist.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris
programme.desc: Chris will unbedingt eine neue Lederjacke haben. Da die Familie nicht genug Geld hat, beschließt Chris' Vater, seinen Sohn mit auf seine Arbeit zu nehmen, wo dieser sich das Geld selbst erarbeiten soll. Doch das ist gar nicht so einfach.

programme.title: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: Als Bud die Sachen für sein Geschäft vom Truck auslädt, wird er angegriffen. Zunächst verschweigt er den Vorfall. Doch Mike erkennt, dass sein Vater langsam alt wird. Deshalb gibt Mike Bud Tipps, wie er sich in Zukunft besser schützen kann. Inzwischen hat Vanessa eine ernste Diskussion mit ihren Töchtern. Es geht um die Unterstützung, die Mike und sie von ihren Töchtern erwarten, wenn sie einmal alt sind.

programme.title: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: Vanessas Schwester April kommt zu Besuch, sie braucht dringend Geld für eine Eizellenspende. Es ist ihre einzige Möglichkeit, ein Baby zu bekommen, deshalb fragt sie Vanessa und Mike um Hilfe.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Malcolm sucht verzweifelt nach einem anständigen Foto-Jahrbuch und konkurriert nun mit den Fotografen. Lois öffnet einen Brief für Malcolm und findet einen Zuschuss für $ 10.000.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Während Lois, Hal und Dewey sich auf eine verhängnisvolle Reise zu einem Klavierwettbewerb begeben, bringt die gefürchtete Großmutter ein Mädchen nach Hause.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Ein Fernsehteam will in Woodstone Mansion eine Folge von "Dumm gestorben" drehen.

programme.title: Pastewka
programme.desc: Bastian versucht mit allen Mitteln, die Aufmerksamkeit von sich auf Kim zu lenken. Dafür beschuldigt er sie öffentlich des Konsums harter Drogen. Diese willigt jedoch erst in das Schauspiel ein, als er ihr 30.000 Euro anbietet.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Roger will sich einen Fernsehabend mit Barbra Streisand mit einem Vogel versüßen. Hayley versucht mit allen Mitteln, ihn davon abzuhalten, doch da hat Roger das Tier schon verspeist. Das hat fatale Folgen für seine Gesundheit. Steve und Stan bereiten sich auf den anstehenden Veteranen-Tag vor, bei dem Steve die Nationalhymne singen soll. Doch seine Stimme lässt sehr zu wünschen übrig.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Als die Lady von der Hamster-Rettungsgesellschaft Hayley als großes Kind bezeichnet hat, lässt sie sich mit zwei von Rogers Persönlichkeiten ein, die eine komplizierte Familiendynamik haben, um zu beweisen, dass sie eine erwachsene Frau ist.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Nachdem ein Vorfall mit einer von Rogers Persönlichkeiten fast tödlich endet, tun sich Steve und Stan zusammen, um die rätselhafte Vergangenheit der Persönlichkeit aufzudecken. Unterdessen erkunden Jeff, Hayley und Francine neue Hobbys.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.sub-title: Das Glück des Philip J. Fry
programme.desc: Fry macht sich auf die Suche nach seinem siebenblättrigen Kleeblatt aus dem 20. Jahrhundert. Dabei muss er an seinen Bruder Yancy denken, der ihm immer alles gestohlen hat. Auf dem Weg zum Friedhof erlebt er eine große Überraschung.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Leela trifft ihren alten Klassenkameraden Adlai wieder, der mittlerweile Schönheitschirurg ist, und lässt sich von ihm ein zweites Auge modellieren. Bender adoptiert währenddessen gleich zwölf Waisenkinder, um mit ihnen Geld zu verdienen.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Louise muss bei Millie eine Schuld begleichen, indem sie an der "Pixie Princess Promenade" teilnimmt. Unterdessen zwingt ein hundeförmiger Blumenstrauß Linda dazu, sich ihrer Vergangenheit zu stellen.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Tina ist beunruhigt, da sie ein Referat mit Zeke vor der gesamten Klasse halten muss. Alleine der Gedanke an diesen Vortrag macht Tina sehr nervös und Mr. Frond will ihr helfen. Daher gibt er ihr einen Glücksbringer, der ihr mit der Nervosität hilft.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Enttäuscht lassen sich die Southparker ihre "Was würde Jesus tun"-Armbänder entfernen, da ein Forscherteam entdeckt hat, dass Jesus nur deshalb wiederauferstehen konnte, weil er leistungssteigernde Hormone genommen hatte. Nur Stan bleibt Jesus treu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obama wird wieder zum Präsidenten gewählt. Doch ist dieses Wahlergebnis zweifelhaft, denn Cartman klaut die Wählerstimmen der Swing States. Die Chinesen geben ihm dafür den Auftrag, sie verlangen jedoch die Rechte an den Star-Wars-Filmen.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Dieses Mal erleben die Smiths Geschehnisse der etwas anderen Art: Nachdem Stan sich beim weihnachtlichen Kirchgang über die Festtags-religiösen aufgeregt hat, beschließt Francine, ihn mit Sex zu versöhnen. Währenddessen geht aber urplötzlich die Welt unter, sodass Stan und Francine sich einer post-apokalyptischen Welt gegenübersehen, in der es nur noch Roger zu geben scheint.

programme.title: American Dad
programme.desc: Der antiliberale Stan ist der Meinung, dass man immer allein auf die Beine kommen kann, und lehnt deshalb den Wohlfahrtsstaat ab. Eine Crack-Sucht führt dazu, dass der antiliberale Stan seine Ansichten zur Gesellschaft ändert.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil schwelgt in alten Erinnerungen, als er das Lied hört, das er mit seiner ersten Freundin assoziiert. Doch dann hat er ein schlechtes Gewissen Claire gegenüber und will das Ganze ungeschehen machen. Alex merkt, dass mit ihm etwas nicht stimmt.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Als Cam und Mitch nur Zusagen für die Hochzeit bekommen, geraten sie in Zweifel, ob sie die Feier überhaupt bezahlen können. Weil er zu stolz ist, will Mitch auch Jay nicht um Unterstützung bitten. Deshalb wollen sie etwas Wertvolles verkaufen.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Während Malcolm, von Hal unterstützt, nach einem College sucht, wohnt das frischvermählte Paar Reese und Raduca in der Garage. Nur Lois ist Raduca von Anfang an ein Dorn im Auge.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Bei einem Arztbesuch erfährt Lois, dass sie das Pfeiffersche Drüsenfieber hat. Natürlich steckt sie sofort Malcolm an, sodass beide eine Woche zusammen in Quarantäne verbringen müssen.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Trevor's Plan, wie er mit Béla wieder zusammenkommen kann, geht jedoch gehörig schief.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Es ist kostenloser Eistag. In der Schule müssen die Kinder an einem Lauf teilnehmen. Sie schmieden einen Plan, um nicht teilnehmen zu müssen. Bob und Linda wollen günstige Tickets für eine Show im Wharf Arts Center bekommen.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Bender wird unverhofft zum Matador in einem besonderen Sport ernannt, dem Käferkampf. In der Arena selbst stellt er jedoch schnell fest, dass diese Sportart ihn an seine Grenzen bringt und er nicht unbedingt siegreich sein muss.

programme.title: Futurama
programme.desc: Der Professor hat ein Mutanten-Team entwickelt, um gegen die Harlem Globetrotters anzutreten. Doch sein Team verliert nicht nur, ihre Mutation führt außerdem dazu, dass die Zeit schneller abläuft und das Ende der Welt kurz bevorsteht.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories
programme.desc: In this Christmas special, James May gets to the heart of the nation's childhood love affair with the model plane and sets out to achieve what seems an impossible dream: the first cross channel flight ever achieved by an engineless, homemade supersized toy. programme.title: James May's Toy Stories
programme.desc: In 2009, five toys were equal to the challenges set by James, but one failed - model trains. James and his team revisit the doomed challenge and make another attempt at building the longest ever model railway track - nearly ten miles long. Linking two Devon towns, Barnstaple and Bideford, the last attempt saw no trains reach their destination.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Steam Train Britain

programme.title: Steam Train Britain

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: The deep is perhaps the most hostile environment on earth, a world of crushing pressure, brutal cold and utter darkness. Exploration has barely begun, and yet it is the largest living space on the planet. Scientists already think that there is more life in the deep than anywhere else on earth.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Coral reefs are home to one-quarter of all marine species and survival in these undersea megacities is a challenge with many different solutions; a turtle heads to the reef's equivalent of a health spa, but she must use trickery to avoid the queue.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: The big blue is the world's greatest wilderness, far from shore and many kilometres deep. It's a vast marine desert where there is little to eat and nowhere to hide. Yet it's home to some of the biggest and most spectacular creatures on earth.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: It is the green of the sea that brings life to oceans. Here, sunlight powers the growth of kelp, mangroves and seagrass. The green seas teem with life, where cuttlefish do battle for a mate and an octopus outwits deadly sharks.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: Mexico is a vast country, over two thousand miles long, dominated by a great chain of mountains, the Sierra Madre. Journey down this rocky spine to discover an amazing diversity of life, from black bears and orchid bees to resplendent quetzals and millions of monarch butterflies. This is a land where giant volcanoes simmer and ancient and modern cultures collide in a festival of life.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and vibrant tropical birds now make their home. It is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld that is still being explored and which holds the key to how animals and people survive the dry season.

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: Northern Mexico is the country's driest region, dominated by two great deserts, the Sonoran and Chihuahuan. Further west, the conditions get hotter, drier and more challenging. This is a look at the forces that have created this arid world.

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

programme.desc: Effects-laden blockbuster about a huge reptile which emerges from the sea to wreak havoc in Manhattan. On a research trip to Chernobyl, a young scientist discovers a startling link between genetic mutation and radioactivity. When a fishing trawler is attacked by an unseen creature, and other evidence of a massive reptilian creature is unearthed, he realises that the creature is following a destructive path to New York.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Humanity faces extinction after a giant comet is discovered heading for Earth. As a desperate mission is launched to stop it, families, leaders and ordinary people confront fear, sacrifice and survival as the countdown begins.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

programme.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior
programme.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: After disappearing for seven years, revolutionary spaceship Event Horizon is rediscovered. The team of scientists sent to investigate find that the entire crew is dead, and a terrifying, malevolent presence is lurking on board.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: The world of genetically engineered children has come to pass, and people are divided into two classes - valid and invalid. The valid are the chosen ones, given the best jobs and are entitled to the best of everything. Vincent Freeman is not a valid, although he harbours a secret desire to join the space programme. He meets a crippled valid who helps him assume his identity in order to fulfil this dream.

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Thriller set at the Stanley Cup ice hockey finals. It's Game 7 and the winner will lift the trophy but with the Vice President attending, a criminal has his eyes on a bigger prize. Holding the VP hostage, his demands are backed up by the shooting of selected hostages and the threat of bombs planted around the stadium. However, a rink security guard, whose kids are in the crowd, refuses to be cowed.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
programme.desc: Something strange is afoot in Sherwood Forest when Robin Hood and his very merry men poke fun at all things green and scarlet in this parody. Robin and his gang have to fight evil Prince John while King Richard is off on a crusade.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Update of the 'Cyrano de Bergerac' story about a long-nosed fire chief who falls in love with a beautiful astronomer. The chief is too ashamed of his appearance to make advances himself but is drawn into assisting his rival, a dull but handsome visiting fireman, from behind the scenes as his chances of love are hampered by his lack of confidence.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: An unscrupulous developer schemes to gain control of the valuable real estate owned by the clean-cut Brady family.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: An ex-professional bowler and his talented Amish protégé hustle their way across the country to a big-money tournament.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: A man who never has enough time for the things he wants to do is offered the chance to change all that through the power of cloning.

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Heading off the tourist track, Clive unearths why volcanic soil makes for the tastiest fruit and veg, learns to make Italian marmalade, uncovers the surprising royal tale behind Italy's first train line and tries his hand at carving jewellery from coral found deep beneath the sea.
